title: Adding one permission such as id-token: write makes actions/checkout fail with 'Repository not found'
symptoms: fatal: repository ... not found during actions/checkout in a private repo
Other steps lose access to packages or issues they used before
cause: As soon as a permissions block lists any scope, every scope not listed is set to none. Adding id-token: write for OIDC silently removes contents: read, which checkout needs on private repositories.
fix: List every scope the job uses alongside the new one.
affected: GitHub Actions workflows with a permissions key, private and internal repositories, as of October 2026
